name: Public Square Historic District
title: Hydro Jetting at Public Square, Medina OH | Medina Hydro Jetting Pros
description: Hydro jetting for Medina's Public Square Historic District: storefronts, restaurants and upper floor apartments. Call (877) 761-0283.
hero: Hydro jetting around Medina's Public Square can clear grease, scale and roots from the drain lines of brick storefronts, restaurants and apartments above them. The district was rebuilt in brick after an 1870 fire, so most buildings carry more than a century of plumbing changes. A camera look at the line first shows what it is made of.
bodyH2: Hydro Jetting for Public Square Buildings
bodyPs: The Main Street Medina [[historic district walking tour|https://www.mainstreetmedina.com/uploads/1/2/3/0/12308576/medina_historic_district_walking_tour_2018.pdf]] explains that Elijah Boardman set aside land in 1817 for a county seat around Public Square, that fires struck in 1848 and 1870, and that the 1870 fire pushed the downtown to rebuild in brick. The district was later restored and listed on the National Register, with overlay zoning created in the early 1990s.

The [[City of Medina's preservation brochure|https://medinaoh.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Brochure-Architectural-Review-and-Historic-Preservation-in-Medina-Ohio.pdf]] says properties in the Public Square Historic District must receive a Certificate of Appropriateness before any work that may change the exterior of a structure or site. Cleaning inside a drain does not change the exterior, but excavation to reach or repair a line can, so it is worth confirming first.

The National Park Service record for the [[Medina Public Square Historic District|https://npgallery.nps.gov/AssetDetail/NRIS/75001483]] lists Greek Revival, Second Empire and Italianate styles, a reminder of how many eras of building share this square. Each era left its own plumbing.

apps.p: Kitchens put fats and solids into drains. The kitchen branch is usually the first to slow.
A shared stack means a low blockage shows on the lowest floor first. Naming affected floors helps.
Buildings put up after the 1870 fire have been altered many times since. Basement drains and wall penetrations may reflect different eras.
A floor drain that backs up first points to the main line.

hero: Hydro jetting along West Liberty Street can clear grease, scale and roots from drain lines serving older homes turned offices, shops and nearby industrial buildings. bodyH2: Hydro Jetting Along West Liberty Street
bodyPs: The Beyond the Storefronts project notes that [[West Liberty was one of the first streets paved|http://www.medinasquare.org/west-liberty-streetnorth]] out from the square. The city's [[comprehensive plan|https://medinaoh.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Comprehensive-Plan-9-12-22.pdf]] names the West Liberty Corridor as a focus area and says small multi-use zones along West Liberty, North Court, North Broadway and Washington Street allow older homes to be repurposed as businesses.

The Library of Congress record for [[Medina Public Square|https://tile.loc.gov/storage-services/master/pnp/habshaer/oh/oh2000/oh2020/data/oh2020data.pdf]] places the square's boundary along Liberty Street, so this corridor runs straight out from the historic center. A house turned office can keep residential pipe while carrying a different load. The same plan says industrial zones sit west of downtown, so some properties here may sit near heavier uses and some near homes.
Whatever the use, hydro jetting suits sound lines with buildup, and an inspection decides.

name: Medfair Heights
title: Hydro Jetting at Medfair Heights, Medina OH | Medina Hydro Jetting Pros
description: Hydro jetting for the Medfair Heights apartment area on North State Road in Medina, OH. Call (877) 761-0283.
hero: Hydro jetting at Medfair Heights can clear grease, scale and roots from the shared drain lines of this wartime-era apartment community. Buildings with many units share stacks and building sewers, so one stoppage can touch many households. An inspection first shows where the blockage sits and how the pipe is holding up.
bodyH2: Hydro Jetting for Medfair Heights Apartment Buildings
bodyPs: The National Park Service lists the [[Medfair Heights Apartment Historic District at 221 North State Street|https://npgallery.nps.gov/AssetDetail/NRIS/08000624]], with 1943 as its significant year, the National Housing Agency among its architects and significance in architecture, community planning and social history. It was listed in 2008, one of [[five historic districts and places|https://nationalregisterofhistoricplaces.com/oh/medina/districts.html]] the register lists for Medina County.

Multi-building apartment complexes share drain infrastructure. A kitchen stack serves several units, and building sewers can carry the output of many households. A blockage low in a stack may show up in the lowest unit first, though its source may be several floors up.

Jetting can clear a sound shared line of grease and scale, and an inspection should come first, especially in buildings of this age. The [[city's brochure|https://medinaoh.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Brochure-Architectural-Review-and-Historic-Preservation-in-Medina-Ohio.pdf]] covers the review process for locally designated properties, which does not apply automatically to every historic listing.
